2609.10824.title: Studying Without a Syllabus: Task-Agnostic Environment Preprocessing
2609.10824.paper_summary: Before an LLM agent tackles tasks in a new environment, it can inspect available corpora and tools and construct reusable resources such as indices, scripts, or procedural guidance. Most automated adaptation methods, however, rely on task examples, trajectories, or evaluation feedback to decide what to build. Existing task-agnostic approaches avoid this supervision but commit in advance to a preparation strategy for a particular type of environment. We study a more open-ended setting: can an agent study an unfamiliar environment without a syllabus, i.e. before test time and without knowledge of the downstream task distribution, and choose how to prepare it? We formalize task-agnostic environment preprocessing, in which a studying system explores an environment under a budget and produces artifacts for a frozen solver. We compare unaided and archive-equipped meta-agents with fixed synthetic-practice and corpus-processing methods across six heterogeneous benchmarks. A meta-agent variant achieves the highest Avg@3 reward on five benchmarks, while fixed corpus processing remains best on the largest corpus benchmark. Larger study budgets do not reliably improve downstream reward. Nevertheless, studied artifacts reduce the test-time sampling needed to reach a given score, demonstrating how reusable preparation can shift computation from repeated test-time attempts to a pre-task study phase.
2609.10824.paper_summary_zh: 在 LLM 代理人處理新環境中的任務之前，它可以檢查可用的語料庫和工具，並構建可重用的資源，例如索引、腳本或程序指導。然後，大多數自動適應方法依賴於任務示例、軌跡或評估反饋來決定建造什麼。然而，現有的任務無關方法避免了這種監督，但提前承諾為特定類型的環境制定準備策略。我們研究了一種更開放的設置：代理人能否在沒有教學大綱的情況下研究不熟悉的環境，即在測試時間之前，並且對下游任務分佈沒有了解，並選擇如何準備它？我們形式化了任務無關的環境預處理，其中學習系統在預算內探索環境並為固定求解器生成工件。我們比較了未幫助的和配備檔案的元代理人，使用固定的合成練習和語料處理方法，涵蓋六個異質基準。一個元代理人變體在五個基準上達到了最高的 Avg@3 獎勵，而固定的語料處理在最大的語料基準上仍然是最佳的。較大的研究預算並不可靠地改善下游獎勵。儘管如此，研究的工件減少了達到給定分數所需的測試時間取樣，顯示了可重用的準備如何將計算從重複的測試時間嘗試轉移到任務前的學習階段。
